data.summary: The marts directory contains core analytics engineering data models (SQL and YAML config) representing publication-ready fact tables, summary metrics, and ranking models.

file_insights.name: _marts.yml
file_insights.summary: YAML configuration file for data models and tests in the marts directory.
file_insights.source_summary: Defines version 2 schema configuration and data tests (not_null, unique, relationships) for the fact_orders model.
file_insights.detailed_description: Contains the YAML configuration and data tests for the models defined in the marts directory, such as fact_orders.
responsibilities: Ensure column uniqueness and non-null constraints

file_insights.name: ads_category_revenue_rank.sql
file_insights.summary: SQL model that calculates category revenue ranks.
file_insights.source_summary: Executes a SQL query on dws_daily_revenue to compute category revenue, order counts, and revenue rank using a window function.
file_insights.detailed_description: Aggregates category revenue and order counts from daily revenue data to rank categories by revenue.
responsibilities: Aggregate revenue and order counts by category
Rank product categories based on total revenue

file_insights.name: dws_daily_revenue.sql
file_insights.summary: Incremental SQL model tracking daily revenue by category.
file_insights.source_summary: Incremental SQL model for daily revenue aggregation with dynamic partition replacement.
file_insights.detailed_description: Computes daily revenue and order counts categorized by product category using an incremental strategy.
responsibilities: Maintain grain at day by category level

file_insights.name: fact_orders.sql
file_insights.summary: SQL model creating the core fact_orders table.
file_insights.source_summary: SQL model constructing the fact_orders table with historical snapshots of product categories and customer tiers.
file_insights.detailed_description: Builds the DWD fact table at the grain of one order item, incorporating as-of joins for dimension versions valid at order time.
responsibilities: Preserve historical dimension states valid at order time
